cases.name: Atlas Performance Club
cases.headline: Turned assessments into a signature member experience.
cases.challenge: High-end members expected data-driven coaching, but manual measurements felt clinical and slowed the sales tour.
cases.solution: Deployed NextBody S30 in a dedicated assessment zone — 32-second scans feed coach dashboards and Before/After 3D avatars for every membership review.
cases.outcome: Increased assessment bookings and improved renewal conversations with visual progress proof.

media.alt: Premium gym assessment zone with NextBody scanner

cases.name: Riyadh Recovery & Wellness
cases.headline: Objective body data for every rehab pathway.
cases.challenge: Therapists needed repeatable composition and posture baselines without sending every client to external labs.
cases.solution: S30 segmental analysis and posture reports integrated into intake — cloud history tracks recovery milestones visit to visit.
cases.outcome: Shorter intake time and clearer member understanding of progress between sessions.

media.alt: Physiotherapy clinic using body composition reports

cases.name: Form Studio Collective
cases.headline: Compact scanner, premium studio footprint.
cases.challenge: A 400 m² studio needed professional-grade body data without dedicating an entire room to hardware.
cases.solution: NextBody S20 at reception — rapid scans become part of onboarding and quarterly check-ins, with mobile reports members share on social.
cases.outcome: Higher attach rate on PT packages tied to scan milestones.

media.alt: Boutique training studio body scan corner

cases.name: Balance Nutrition Lab
cases.headline: From subjective scales to 3D evidence.
cases.challenge: Nutrition programs lacked visceral fat and segmental muscle data clients could act on between consults.
cases.solution: S30 composition reports — BMR, visceral fat level, WHR — anchor every meal plan review with trend charts over 12 weeks.
cases.outcome: Stronger program adherence when clients see 3D Before/After avatars.

media.alt: Nutrition clinic reviewing body composition trends

cases.name: Lumen Medical Wellness
cases.headline: Clinical-grade data in a spa-grade environment.
cases.challenge: Medical wellness guests demanded credible metrics while expecting a luxury hospitality experience.
cases.solution: Assessment suites equipped with S30 — encrypted cloud reports shared with in-house physicians and trainers under role-based access.
cases.outcome: Premium package upsell tied to quarterly body intelligence reviews.

cases.name: Pulse Fitness Group
cases.headline: Standardized assessments across locations.
cases.challenge: A 6-club operator needed one consistent member report format for regional marketing and retention campaigns.
cases.solution: S20 roll-out with centralized cloud dashboard — HQ compares scan volume, retention cohorts, and coach utilization per club.
cases.outcome: Unified retention playbook deployed across all branches.
